verdict.rationale: The probe shows the REST API requires registered API keys and returns a structured auth challenge. The developer suite also publishes a dedicated Authorisation guide. The data API is described as simple GET retrieval, so a key is effectively read-only, but nothing documents per-key scopes, permission selection, or least-privilege controls for agents. missing for 10: documented credential scopes/permission granularity, per-agent key issuance and revocation controls, separation of read vs write (filing) credentials, independent corroboration.
